name: How do I choose between painting existing doors and replacing them?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between painting existing doors and replacing them?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your doors are structurally sound and fit their frames well, repainting is the most cost-effective way to update your home's interior. However, replacement is the better choice if doors are warped, hollow cores are punctured, or you want to upgrade lightweight doors to solid-core for sound dampening. If you plan to change existing trim profiles or reframe openings during a larger remodel, installing pre-hung door packages often makes more sense than prepping damaged, outdated slabs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Paint if doors hang straight and function well. Replace them if slabs are warped, structurally cracked, or if you want solid-core sound insulation.
